sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Sorting the Relationships column did nothing: `_sortCellText()` returns '' for every relationship cell (its icons carry no visible text), so both comparators compared '' against '' regardless of icon count. `_sortColumnKind()` now classifies 'Relationships' as a new 'count' kind, sorted by the number of relationship icons (`.mb-rel-filter-key` spans) in each cell instead of cell text.
